clean.title: textstat words — count the words in a file

ambiguity.title: freq --min — hide short words
ambiguity.defect: ambiguity: "short" is never defined — is a word of length N kept or dropped? (the only example has no word of exactly length N)

contradiction.title: textstat time --seconds — reading time in seconds
contradiction.defect: contradiction: the rules say round down, the 7-word example (2.1 → 3) rounds up

missing-criterion.title: textstat freq --json — machine-readable output
missing-criterion.defect: missing acceptance criterion: the unreadable-file rule ({"error": …} on stdout, and its exit code) has no example, no acceptance criterion and no exit code
